turns.zh: 15号桌的客人喜欢上菜快一点。

turns.text: So we speed up their tickets.
turns.zh: 所以我们就加快他们的出餐速度。

turns.text: So we add an extra amuse not to back up the kitchen.
turns.zh: 所以我们就多加一道开胃小点，免得厨房堵单。

turns.text: 22 doesn't like people to speak to them.
turns.zh: 22号桌的客人不喜欢别人跟他们说话。
